context.en: Greaves’s 1650 edition carries Ulugh Beg’s calendrical work into a later printed form. This London title page represents transmission of the scholarly results, not the observatory building or a manuscript made there.
context.zh: 格里夫斯1650年的刊本将兀鲁伯的历法成果传入后世印刷文本。这张伦敦印本扉页呈现学术成果的传播，并非天文台建筑或在那里制作的手稿。
